arabic text: AY ALI KE PISAR, FATEMA KA JIGAR\nYA HASSAN YA HASSAN\nYA HASSAN YA HASSAN
english translation text: O SON OF ALI (A.S), O LOVE OF FATEMA (A.S),

arabic text: LAB PE JISKE NABI CHUMTE THE KABHI\nZEHR AB US LABO NE PIYA HAI ABHI\nKHOON ME HAI KAFAN, DEKHTI HAI BEHEN
english translation text: THE LIPS OF THE ONE WHICH PROPHET USED TO KISS, THERE IS NOW POISON ON THOSE LIPS,\nTHE SHROUD IS COVERED IN BLOOD, AND HIS SISTER IS WATCHING

arabic text: DEKHA QASSIM KA TUKRE PARA HAI BADAN\nRUKH MADINA KIYA AUR KAHA YA HASSAN\n'YA HUSSAIN'
english translation text: AAGAYE LASH PAR JABKE SHAH E ZAMAN\nWHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) REACHED THE BODY OF QASIM, HE SAW THE PIECES OF THE BODY,\nHE FACED MEDINA AND SAID

arabic text: AAPA SHEHR THA AAPKA THA WATAN\nROZAE NANA PAR HO NA PAAE DAFAN
english translation text: MARHALA AAP PAR KITNA THA WHO KATHAN\nIT WAS SUCH A DIFFICULT TIME FOR IMAM HASAN (A.S.), HE WAS IN HIS OWN CITY AND HIS OWN COMMUNITY,\nEVEN THEN YOU WERE NOT ALLOWED TO BE BURIED NEAR PROPHET (S.A)
